D2-cost routing and budget definition
facts.value: D2-cost definition: whole fields in priority order (fixed-seed random order inside ties); a field is routed while observed spend plus its development-estimated expected cost (calls: 1 + P(check | model, action); tokens: mean reflect tokens + P(check) x mean check tokens, development logs) fits the budget; observed spend charges the realised calls (one check call only when the action proposed a change) and mean-token estimates per call (token logs per dataset, model and stage); stops at the first field that does not fit. Budget per model: the structural router's spend (calls, or mean-token estimates). No fractional fields.

cost_check.definition: D2-cost definition: whole fields in priority order (fixed-seed random order inside ties); a field is routed while observed spend plus its development-estimated expected cost (calls: 1 + P(check | model, action); tokens: mean reflect tokens + P(check) x mean check tokens, development logs) fits the budget; observed spend charges the realised calls (one check call only when the action proposed a change) and mean-token estimates per call (token logs per dataset, model and stage); stops at the first field that does not fit. Budget per model: the structural router's spend (calls, or mean-token estimates). No fractional fields.
